coordinates.object_orientation: +Z along shell long axis from anterior channel (near Z=0) to posterior recessed-spire end. Ventral slit faces -Y; dorsal inflated surface +Y; width axis X. This museum-display orientation intentionally puts the aperture in front and posterior end in top, without changing canonical cameras.

concept.reason: Real named specimen photograph shows dorsal, ventral and posterior end views with scale. Primary visual requirements are exposed directly; no synthetic concept needed and no denied image action is bypassed.

name: Siphocypraea cowrie fossil
target: Original fossil-shell target retained: inflated smooth oval cowrie, anterior extension of the aperture as a short channel, and long toothed ventral slit. Not a living animal and not a generic unbroken oval pebble.

reference_specimen.source: Neogene Atlas of Ancient Life named specimen, three photographic views
reference_specimen.provenance: Plio-Pleistocene of Hendry County, Florida; formation unknown. Do not silently assign Caloosahatchee or a precise age.
reference_specimen.scope: Original low-poly specimen-informed external shell study, not a scanned replica or exact museum specimen facsimile.
reference_specimen.period: Inventory quaternary is retained as a representative thematic interval; source specimen only broadly dated Plio-Pleistocene, crossing the boundary.

must_have: Smooth inflated oval dorsal shell with broad shoulders and rounded flanks; width about 0.56 of long axis
Narrow near-full-length ventral aperture with real recessed interior, not painted black slit
Thick unequal opposing lips; short rounded transverse teeth visibly project into slit from BOTH sides, simplified ~18–24 per side; do not imply exact taxonomic tooth count
At anterior end slit continues into a short open channel/notch with slightly extended lips, not a long tubular proboscis
Posterior end contains a recessed, largely concealed spire with a comma-like curved furrow connecting the aperture around it, visible in top/end view
Long-axis taper is subtle and asymmetric; broad dorsal hump contrasted with flatter ventral lip region
must_not_have: No raised pointed turret spire, fins, tentacles, mantle, operculum or rock base
No closed seamless egg with decal aperture
No long conch siphonal tube, wide trumpet opening or circular naticid mouth
No copied museum numbers, cracks, mineral stains, photo texture or reference mesh
No complete hidden internal coil/chambers invented from these exterior photographs
morphology.simplification: Faceted shell body may be smooth shaded with deliberate large silhouette planes. Teeth should be low rounded ribs integrated into lip geometry, not a row of floating sharp cubes. Omit fine abrasion/mineral staining and microscopic growth marks.

scale.source: PRI69852 image has an actual 3cm line approximately184px. Long shell ~407px, width~227px and end-view height~210px imply approximately66x37x34mm. Pixel/projection estimates, not caliper measurements.
scale.separate_comparison: PRI76742 is another specimen stated ~8cm by PRI. It is contextual corroboration only and must NOT replace PRI69852 scale or locality.

acceptance_focus: Front (-Y): long slit, both tooth rows and open anterior channel clearly visible
Side (+X): inflated dorsal hump and flattened aperture-side lips, not a flat ellipse
Top (+Z): real depressed spire with curved posterior furrow, no opaque cap filling it
Perspective (+X,-Y,+Z): oval volume plus slit/teeth/posterior recess legible together
No unintentional surface cracks; deliberate aperture has wall thickness and short recessed interior. Teeth may share geometry or be joined but not visibly float.
evidence_limits: Three real views are sufficient for low-poly external morphology, not exact internal anatomy or a watertight museum scan
Photographic perspective gives approximate dimensions and intermediate surfaces require modest interpolation
Bone-beige fossil palette is artistic neutral coloration, not evidence of the living shell pattern
maker_workflow: Store 3–4 cheap gray checks under private/ before final rendering; catch slit occlusion and posterior furrow problems first
Four final views front/side/top/perspective; preview may reuse perspective. No extra default spin or many-view suite
Self-contained deterministic generator; if canonical helpers used copy into source/deps and freeze relative path/sha256, never import another model directory
Run existing two isolated rebuilds, GLB/Khronos and required geometry checks; prep helper does NOT grant science or visual QA PASS
Same localdir through maker and QA. Maker notifies root and FINAL without uploads/cleanup; root handles stable backup asynchronously
